notes: Standard WooCommerce (Neve/Nova theme) with a YITH WooCommerce Ajax Navigation (yith_wcan) game filter, server-rendered, requests+BS4 works cleanly. Page 1 uses the base URL (no /page/1/ suffix), pages 2+ use /shop/page/{page}/ with the same yith_wcan/filter_game/query_type_game query params appended. CONTAINER CLASS stock logic (like tcgkauppa.fi): check product_container's own class list for 'instock' vs 'outofstock' — no separate in_stock selector needed, hence null above; scraper must inspect the <li> element's class attribute directly. Caveat: the 'filter_game=pokemon' filter returns ~179 pages (2680 items) because it includes individual Pokemon TCG singles and generic accessories (sleeves, playmats, toploaders), not just sealed products — a real scraper likely wants to further restrict to product_cat values like product_cat-pokemon-boosters-blisters-etbs / product_cat-pokemon-decks-tins-boxes to avoid scraping thousands of single-card listings. max_pages set to the observed page count but should probably be capped much lower once category filtering is added.
